snapshot.what_it_does: Hindustan Unilever Limited (HUL) is India's largest FMCG company, serving consumers for over 90 years with a portfolio of 50 brands across 15 categories spanning Home Care, Beauty & Wellbeing, Personal Care and Foods. It reaches 9 out of 10 Indian households through a distribution network of over 9 million retail outlets, supported by R&D, AI-enabled operations and a large manufacturing footprint.

segments.name: Home Care
segments.share: ₹23,672 Cr revenue (largest segment; ~37% of HUL per p7)
segments.note: Fabric wash and household care (Wheel, Surf excel, Vim, Rin, Comfort); 19% segment margin, EBIT ₹4,521 Cr

segments.name: Beauty & Wellbeing
segments.note: Skin care, colour cosmetics, hair care (Dove, Simple, Minimalist, TRESemmé); 28% segment margin, EBIT ₹4,161 Cr

segments.name: Foods
segments.note: Beverages, lifestyle nutrition, packaged foods (Horlicks, Bru); 20% segment margin, EBIT ₹2,824 Cr

segments.name: Personal Care
segments.note: Oral care, deodorants, skin cleansing; 19% segment margin, EBIT ₹1,805 Cr

snapshot.geographies: India — the report describes operations across urban and rural India (9 Mn+ outlets reached); no international revenue breakdown is stated.

promised_vs_delivered.verdict: Credibility is high: management's H2 FY26 recovery call, Ice Cream demerger timeline, and 22.5-23.5% margin guidance were all met through FY26. Only blemish is Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin of 22.4% (actuals), marginally below the guided band; FY27 growth promises remain unproven but are tracking well.

bull.point: Scale and mix: 50 brands, 9M+ outlets, 90% household reach; Home Care ₹23,672 Cr anchors ₹63,763 Cr FY26 turnover.
Profit engine: FY26 EBITDA margin 23.6%, PAT ₹10,652 Cr, ROCE 110.9%, operating cash flow ₹15,839 Cr funding ₹41 dividend.
Momentum/credibility: H2 FY26 recovery delivered; Q2 FY27 revenue +12.2% YoY after Q1 USG 10%, with guidance largely met.

bear.point: Margin slippage: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin 22.4% actual, below 22.5-23.5% guided band; Q1 was 22.8%.
PAT quality uneven: Dec-2025 PAT ₹6,607 Cr (+121%) coincided with demerger one-off; Sep-2026 PAT grew only 3.9% despite +12.2% revenue.
Growth was modest before FY27: FY26 USG 5%; four quarters to Mar-2025 revenue stayed ₹15.7-15.9k Cr as margins eased 23.8%→23.1%.

watch: Whether Q3 FY27 EBITDA margin returns to the 22.5-23.5% band after Q2's 22.4%.
If revenue growth stays double-digit with healthy UVG/USG balance after Q1 USG 10% and Q2 revenue +12.2%.
One-off/demerger effects washing out of PAT and any update on the FY27 'better than FY26' growth promise.
